_comment: What scripts/build-sw.py needs to know about this course. The generator
is the same file in all seven repositories on shamsfelfel.github.io;
everything that differs between them is here. See the header of
scripts/build-sw.py for every key. Until now this repository had no
generator at all and its worker was hand-written, with a cache name
bumped by hand -- and a worker whose name never changes never
reinstalls, so an installed reader kept stale assets for ever.
This course has two caches, with different owners, and every setting
below follows from that:
esl-<hash>       the app itself. This worker fills it and clears it.
esl-content-v1   the PDFs and the audio the student chose to save.
app.js owns it; the worker reads it and never writes
to or empties it, because a file she paid data for
must not disappear on an update -- not on this app's
own update, and not on a sibling course's.
So lessons/ and tests/ are NOT precached: a hundred PDFs and eighty
MP3s are a download the student makes deliberately, lesson by lesson,
not something an install does to her connection behind her back. That
is also what runtime_cache: "precache" is for -- a lesson file fetched
on a cache miss is served and forgotten, never quietly saved.
range_support is the other half: a phone's audio player asks for byte
ranges when the listener seeks, and a cached response handed back whole
answers 200, which players treat as unseekable or refuse outright.
